(A) 3pm to 4pm
(B) 7am to 9am
(C) 9am to 3pm
(D) 6am to 7am

- From 9am to 3pm, Leslie was seen buying a bike.
- From 3pm to 4pm, Leslie was seen driving to the water park.

This means Leslie was occupied until 4pm. The only time slot after 4pm when the movies were still open is between 4pm and the closing time, which is not specified but must be after 4pm.

The only option that fits within this time frame is (C) 9am to 3pm, but since Leslie was occupied from 3pm to 4pm, the only possible time for the movies would be after 4pm.

Answer: (C)
